# Battery Cell Performance Characterization - Test Dataset B28

## 1. Operating Specifications and Protocol
This experimental report documents the electrochemical cycling, thermal behavior, and
operational parameters for commercial lithium-ion test cells evaluated under laboratory validation protocols.

The metadata sheet records that the current channel is signed so that charge produces positive numbers.
The deposit configuration excludes the voltage quantity entirely, so measurement-status semantics are outside scope.
Laboratory notes record that charge capacity is reset on step boundaries.
A rate comment exists for temperature without listing the actual sampling conditions.

Baseline environmental chamber temperature was maintained at 25.0 C across all test runs.

Deposit documentation records the measurement unit of voltage as mV.

### 1.1 Detailed Instrumentation and Channel Mapping
Galvanostatic cycling was conducted using an automated multi-channel battery test system.

Channel voltages were calibrated against secondary standards prior to dataset acquisition.

The data dictionary lists the completeness method for current exclusively as completeness_counter.
The deposit configuration omits all test index structure; index-recovery methods are consequently undefined.
Within the dataset the charge/discharge state is determined by: mode_code_enum, step_type_column.

## 2. Archival Summary and End of Report
Validation dataset B28 concluded without hardware interrupt flags.

---
End of Report B28.
